title: Motorcycle OBD-II Telemetry Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obd:bike
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(bike_id) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many motorcycle OBD-II telemetry events land each day and how many distinct bike values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest motorcycle OBD-II telemetry records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct bike values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much motorcycle OBD-II telemetry activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
